title: PVL: Nxled picks up pieces after twice-to-beat collapse

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nxled’s impressive elimination round run turned into a fluke after it blew a twice-to-beat advantage against fourth-seeded Farm Fresh in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab series semifinals. Nxled leaned on Brooke Van Sickle’s all-around performance of 18 points, 23 receptions and 22 digs to recover from a two-set deficit, but it wasn’t enough to stop Farm Fresh from reaching the finals for the first time, 26-24, 25-16, 23-25, 17-25, 15-11, on Thursday at Philsports Arena. Frustrated with their heartbreaking semis exit, Lyann De Guzman spoke on behalf of her team. “Of course, it’s disappointing because we’re already […]...
